# Portal Setup

## Basics
- Which language will participants speak? [pick one: English, Dutch, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Ukrainian, Czech] [options in two columns]
- What must be provided before each portal conversation? [pick any: A name, An email] [optional]
- Can participants ask to be emailed when the report is ready? [pick one: Yes, No] [optional] [only if What must be provided before each portal conversation? includes An email]
- Which tutorial should participants see first? [pick one: None, Basic, Advanced]
- Which tags can participants pick from? Separate them with commas. [optional] [short answer]

## Participant features
- Should participants be able to use Explore? [pick one: Yes, No]
- Which Explore mode? [pick one: Summarize, Brainstorm, Custom] [only if Should participants be able to use Explore? is Yes]
- What should Explore's custom reply prompt say? [only if Which Explore mode? is Custom]
- Should participants be able to use Verify? [pick one: Yes, No]
- Which topics should Verify check? Pick at least one. [pick any: Actions, Agreements, Disagreements, Gems, Moments, Truths] [only if Should participants be able to use Verify? is Yes]
- Remind participants to verify when they finish? [pick one: Yes, No] [optional] [only if Should participants be able to use Verify? is Yes]

## Portal content
- What's the portal page's title? [short answer]
- What should the portal page say? [optional]
- What should participants see when they're done? [optional]

## Advanced
- Any key terms the transcriber should know? Separate them with commas. [optional] [short answer]
- Anonymize transcripts? [pick one: Yes, No]
- Generate conversation titles and tags automatically? [pick one: Yes, No]
- How should titles be written? (optional custom prompt) [optional] [only if Generate conversation titles and tags automatically? is Yes]
